ratings.concept: Alcohols to alkyl chlorides with HCl: primary and secondary alcohols need anhydrous $\mathrm{ZnCl_2}$ (Lucas reagent), a tertiary alcohol reacts with HCl alone
ratings.strategy_evidence: Reaction i, ethanol with HCl and anhydrous $\mathrm{ZnCl_2}$, is a printed preparation of ethyl chloride; accepting i alone strikes out options 1 and 2, which both leave i out.

traps.label: partial_combination
traps.route: Keeps only the secondary alcohol in iv. Reactions i and iii work as well, so the answer is three reactions, not one.

traps.label: partial_combination
traps.route: Leaves i out, treating a primary alcohol as unreactive. Ethanol does give ethyl chloride once anhydrous $\mathrm{ZnCl_2}$ is there.

traps.label: condition_ignored
traps.route: Reads i and ii as the same reaction because both are ethanol plus HCl. Without the anhydrous $\mathrm{ZnCl_2}$ written over the arrow in i, reaction ii does not go.

ratings.reason: This question requires applying the reagent rule under the condition printed over each arrow, demonstrated by i and ii being the same ethanol-plus-HCl pair separated only by "Anhyd.ZnCl2", with just one of them keyed as a preparation.
ratings.note: The lettered block is printed as four reactions rather than four prose statements, which is still list_of_statements: three or more lettered items above the options, and the options select a subset of them. The block is labelled i. to iv. in lower case while the options read "I, III and IV only" in upper case; the mapping is unambiguous and is noted only as a tidy-up.

group_note: This packet holds one question, so consistency across members was not at stake; the test applied was the one the other statement-block packets use - the primary type is set by whether a lettered block is printed above the options (it is, so list_of_statements rather than statement_options), and the format by whether the options select from that block (they do, so pick_correct_combination). Demand is condition_based_reasoning rather than plain application because reactions i and ii differ in nothing but the anhydrous $\mathrm{ZnCl_2}$ over the arrow: remove that printed condition and option 4 becomes defensible. Its matching trap, condition_ignored, is therefore the device on option 4, while options 1 and 2 are true-but-short subsets and carry partial_combination with the omitted reaction named. No trap is placed on option 3, the printed key.
